gates.reasons: A: audit KILL is decisive — MPD/FODMP already use ProDMP-parameterized chunk heads with guaranteed initial position/velocity continuity and evaluate on MetaWorld/ManiSkill; the frozen-VLM <500M framing is an application retarget, and the candidate's own prior-art search missed the exact-mechanism papers. F: a CoRL/RA-L PC would cite MPD/FODMP on page one and read this as porting a known head into a VLA, in an already-crowded compact-action-head atlas.

A: audit KILL holds — HIR (Jiang et al., NeurIPS 2019) already does ground-truth-predicate hindsight language relabeling with HER's explicit future/final schedule; moving it from an RL replay buffer to BC/few-shot LIBERO is a paradigm/domain transfer, not a new mechanism, and CAST covers the VLM-label variant. F: the residual contribution is an empirical characterization of a known trick in a new setting; that plus reliance on simulator oracle predicates makes it a workshop-grade delta for a Q1/Q2 PC.

A: unaudited and fails under required extra skepticism — SmolVLA's own async inference stack already triggers re-inference when the action queue drops below a threshold, so the core 'queue-occupancy-gated backbone invocation' duplicates the baseline serving mode; the Tassiulas-Ephremides framing is a rename, and the only residual delta is a frame-diff interrupt heuristic. B: latency is the bottleneck the mission explicitly flags as crowded-fixes-rejected, and the marginal effect size over the existing queue-threshold async baseline is not plausible. C: backpressure's max-throughput stability guarantee is vacuous for a single queue — no mechanistic account of why this beats the existing threshold scheduler; the robustness claim rests on an untied heuristic. F: PC reads it as serving-loop engineering in the crowded replan-cadence cluster.

A: unaudited and fails under required extra skepticism — masking the model's own highest-attention/most-discriminative regions during training is an established regularization family (attention-based dropout layers, adversarial erasing, hide-and-seek style occlusion); the SnapKV/H2O scoring source is cosmetic, the scanner itself flags this as the thinnest-differentiation idea, and the listed prior art only covers the weaker inference-time side of the comparison. F: a PC would classify it as an attention-guided dropout variant applied to VLAs — an augmentation-trick paper unlikely to clear the CoRL/RA-L contribution bar on its own.

A: UNAUDITED in an admitted 7-candidate replan-cadence cluster; sole delta over DVAC is 'stateful window vs memoryless threshold', and AIMD's formal properties (multi-flow fairness/convergence to fair share) do not transfer to a single-agent cadence loop, so the borrowed theory is decorative branding on uncertainty-triggered replanning that already exists. F: adaptive replan cadence is crowded and latency fixes are flagged as crowded/rejected; a PC reads this as a heuristic scheduler with a TCP name, not a contribution.

A: UNAUDITED; observation-drift-triggered chunk abort/regenerate is the same crowded replan-cadence cluster mechanism with database vocabulary ('read-set') as the only delta. C: internal contradiction — comparing the 'fresh pooled feature' against the cached snapshot requires running the vision encoder/backbone per step, which is exactly the cost the 'few FLOPs, no model call' validation claims to avoid; the cheap-conflict-detection premise the causal story rests on is false as specified. E: once validation requires per-step encoding the latency claim collapses, leaving at most 2 plausibly improved dimensions (robustness, SR). F: crowded staleness/replan area plus a mechanically broken cost story would not survive review.

A: UNAUDITED; dispatching encoders asynchronously and stalling on data dependencies is standard systems pipelining, not an affirmatively new research mechanism. B: misidentifies the bottleneck — language is cached and proprio projection is near-free, so the 'wasted interval' the scoreboard recovers is approximately zero; the latency is the VLM vision prefix itself. C: false architectural premise — in SmolVLA/pi0-class experts every denoising step cross-attends the full VLM KV prefix (dominated by vision tokens), so no denoising step can legally issue before vision returns and the hazard-scoped wait degenerates to the existing barrier. D: that dependency structure is shared across the whole VLA class, so the mechanism has no purchase anywhere, and it additionally demands a per-architecture forward-path refactor. E: negligible achievable speedup, cannot plausibly improve >=3 dimensions. F: no measurable gain to report; unpublishable.

A: UNAUDITED, self-admitted clear overlap with HiPolicy/AAC/Adaptive Q-Chunking in a crowded adaptive-chunking area; the surviving twist (Thompson sampling with a safe-default arm) is a training-procedure detail, and the advertised regret bound does not actually hold under sparse delayed episodic reward with non-stationary context, so the sole differentiator is decorative. F: a CoRL/RA-L PC reads this as incremental adaptive chunk-size selection with a borrowed database framing whose formal guarantee doesn't survive scrutiny.

A: unaudited; with a frozen backbone cached vectors need zero incremental maintenance, so the view-selection cost-benefit formulation degenerates to frequency caching — a heuristic swap vs VLA-Cache-class prior art, not a new mechanism. B: targets latency/compute (crowded, mission-rejected area) via the language-conditioning path, a minor cost slice — vision dominates and must be recomputed per frame; LIBERO's tiny static instruction set makes cross-episode workload skew trivial. C: no concrete definition of the 'lattice' of cacheable intermediates in a VLA forward pass; the expensive intermediates are vision-dependent and uncacheable across episodes. E: plausible gains limited to marginal latency/compute; 'parameter efficiency' claim contradicted by the added ~1M-param matcher; cannot reach 3 dims. F: crowded VLA-caching area; a caching-policy swap with marginal sim savings will not survive a PC.

A: unaudited; exploiting cross-denoising-step redundancy is a heavily mined diffusion-acceleration axis (DeepCache-style step caching, consistency/one-step distillation for policies), and FlowRAM/SpatialVLA-Mamba already fuse Mamba with flow-matching — the axis-swap twist is thin, not affirmatively new. B: attacks the action expert's per-step cost, but the evidenced latency bottleneck is the backbone, capping end-to-end gain at a small slice; latency fixes are the mission's flagged crowded area. E: threading state across ODE steps breaks simulation-free flow-matching training (requires sequential unrolls, ~10x per-sample training cost, unaddressed), and plausible improvement covers at most marginal latency/compute — under 3 dims. F: incremental efficiency tweak in a space where one-step/consistency distillation already dominates; PC rejects as minor.

A: spectral-radius-near-critical init is textbook reservoir-computing/ESN practice; applying a known init/regularizer to a hypothetical add-on module is not a new mechanism, and the scanner itself demotes it to an ablation. B: attacks long-horizon collapse only conditionally on a recurrent memory module that stock SmolVLA/pi0/OFT lack; no plausible effect-size case. C: edge-of-chaos memory-capacity results hold for untrained reservoirs; trained GRUs drift from their init under gradient descent, so the init-to-LIBERO-Long-SR causal chain is vibes. D: attaches to no existing VLA as-is — requires first bolting on a memory module that is itself the real contribution. E: near-zero cost but no affirmatively strong case it improves even one of the seven dims, let alone three. F: an initialization ablation is not a paper-level contribution at CoRL/RA-L; the scanner concurs it is not standalone.

A: unaudited with extra skepticism owed; k-center-greedy over frozen embeddings is the canonical 2018 data-selection baseline — retargeting it to demo selection for IL finetuning is an application/experiment, not a new mechanism, in an active data-curation-for-robot-IL area (Demo-SCORE adjacency acknowledged by the candidate itself). F: a standard off-the-shelf baseline applied to LIBERO reads as an empirical study/workshop result, not a CoRL/RA-L mechanism contribution; the fixed-budget-K-from-a-larger-collected-pool setting is also artificial since the pool demos already exist, undercutting the labeling-budget motivation.

A: unaudited + scanner's own check finds ROSER functionally adjacent in the most-crowded retrieval-augmented few-shot area; cracking is a systems transplant differentiator, not a new mechanism (novelty_confidence 0.3, ranked last). B: attacks index-maintenance cost at <=25 demos where brute-force kNN is already free; no evidenced bottleneck engaged with plausible effect size. C: causal story ends at 'cheaper retrieval', vacuous at n<=25; no path to SR/generalization; presupposes a retrieval-conditioning pathway SmolVLA lacks. D: attachment point (retrieval memory) does not exist in SmolVLA/pi0/OFT-class VLAs; requires building that subsystem into each first. E: cannot plausibly improve >=3 dimensions — compute/latency savings negligible at this scale, SR/data-efficiency/generalization gains unsupported. F: reads as a database micro-optimization with no measurable robotics benefit in crowded territory; would not survive a CoRL/RA-L PC.
